descriptor.name: Agricultural weather services
descriptor.shortDesc: Live weather observations, forecasts, and weather-informed agricultural advisories.
descriptor.longDesc: This catalog advertises weather information available OnDemand. Requested coordinates, observation times, forecasts, measured values, and advice are returned as Direct Resources after Provider invocation.

descriptor.name: Weather Services Provider
descriptor.shortDesc: Provider of weather observations, forecasts, and agricultural advisories.
descriptor.longDesc: The Provider combines station observations and forecast models to serve agricultural weather use cases.

descriptor.name: Live weather observation and forecast
descriptor.shortDesc: Returns location-specific measured or forecast weather parameters.
descriptor.longDesc: The catalog advertises the supported subject, languages, coverage, and Observe interaction. The response supplies the requested geometry, applicable time, provenance, and parameter values.

descriptor.name: Weather-informed agricultural advisory
descriptor.shortDesc: Produces agricultural guidance using forecast weather parameters.
descriptor.longDesc: The capability supports point-level guidance for irrigation, spraying, and crop protection using rainfall, wind speed, humidity, and temperature forecasts.
